name: Reef Guardian
location:
Y'ffelon
Carapace Cavern, Western Solstice's shores, Shore south of Xor-Hist, east of Xul-Haj

abilities.name: Claw
abilities.description: Basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Pulverise
abilities.description: A stronger melee attack dealing moderate physical damage and slightly staggering the target. Blocking negates the stagger.

abilities.name: Crushing Limbs
abilities.description: A charged melee attack dealing moderate physical damage and stunning for 1 second. This can be blocked to stagger the Reef Guardian instead.

abilities.name: Acid Reflux
abilities.description: The Reef Guardian pins itself in place and continuously sprays acid while slowly turning to face its target, dealing continuous direct minor poison damage in a cone.

notes: The Reef Guardian in Dreadsail Reef is a difficulty 3 raid boss, but the ones in the Galen and Solstice zones are difficulty 1 respawning enemies. This makes it one of the very few creatures in the game to appear as both without the boss version being differentiated in name.
related_quests: Guardian of Y'ffelon: Go to Y'ffelon and stop the Firesong Circle.
summary: This article is about the overland Reef Guardian. For the Dreadsail Reef boss, see Reef Guardian (Dreadsail Reef). Reef Guardians are a type of golem made from coral and possessing a blue glow. They resemble Magma Golems. They can be found along the coasts of Y'ffelon and Solstice.
